name: Berry overnight oats
instructions: Mix the oats and yogurt in a jar or bowl.
Fold in the berries, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Stir before serving and add extra fruit if you like.

name: Spinach egg wrap
instructions: Whisk the eggs in a bowl and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Cook the spinach briefly in a skillet, then add the eggs and scramble until just set.
Place the filling in the tortilla, fold it up, and warm for a minute before serving.

name: Chicken rice bowl
instructions: Season the chicken and cook it in a skillet until browned and fully cooked.
Steam or roast the broccoli until tender and fluffy.
Serve the chicken and broccoli over warm rice and add your preferred sauce or seasoning.

name: Turkey hummus sandwich
instructions: Spread hummus evenly over both slices of bread.
Layer the turkey slices on one side and add any extra vegetables you like.
Close the sandwich and serve immediately or pack it for later.

name: Lentil feta salad
instructions: Place the lentils in a large bowl and add the halved tomatoes.
Crumble over the feta and toss gently to combine.
Season with salt, pepper, and a splash of dressing before serving.

name: Salmon with potatoes
instructions: Roast or boil the potatoes until tender, then season with salt and pepper.
Cook the salmon in the oven or on a skillet until it flakes easily.
Steam the green beans until crisp-tender and serve alongside the salmon and potatoes.

name: Beef taco bowl
instructions: Brown the beef in a frying pan and season with taco spices.
Warm the black beans and rice in a saucepan or microwave.
Assemble in bowls with beef, beans, rice, and any taco toppings you like.

name: Chickpea coconut curry
instructions: Add the chickpeas and coconut milk to a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted and the sauce thickens slightly.
Serve the curry hot with rice, naan, or your preferred side.

name: Tofu noodle stir-fry
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Pan-fry the tofu until golden, then add the vegetables and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Mix in the noodles and toss with sauce before serving warm.

name: Greek yogurt fruit bowl
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Slice the banana over the top and sprinkle on the almonds.
Serve immediately or chill for a few minutes before eating.

name: Cottage cheese toast
instructions: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread the cottage cheese over the slices and top with tomato slices.
Season lightly and serve as a quick snack or light meal.

name: Peanut butter banana smoothie
instructions: Add the milk, banana, and peanut butter to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.
